docs.description: CSS selector of the element whose headings it lists. Default: the closest <article>, else <main>, else the page. A list of links inside the element wins over it.
The headings to list, e.g. "h2 h3". Deeper levels are indented.
Heading of the list, and the accessible name of the navigation.
Adds a first entry that leads back to the start of the content, e.g. "Intro". It is the current one while the start of the content is in view.
A media query. While it matches, the list folds into a bar with the current section and the reading progress, and opens from it, e.g. "(max-width: 64rem)".
Show the reading progress under the heading as well (the compact bar always shows it).

events.name: sb-section
events.description: When the reader scrolls into another section. detail: { id } (empty before the first heading).
